title: Technology Sector Update for 08/15/2018: PRSP,GDDY,DXC
text:

Technology stocks were mostly lower Wednesday afternoon, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 losing just under 1.0% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was falling nearly 1.6%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
+ Perspecta's ( PRSP ) advanced Wednesday, at one point rising over 10%, after the technology consultant reported improved fiscal Q1 net income compared with year-ago levels and also beating Wall Street estimates. Excluding one-time items, the company earned $0.54 per share during the April-to-June reporting period, up from $0.36 during the same quarter last year and beating the three-analyst consensus call. Revenue increased to $793 million from $676 million last year.
In other sector news:
- GoDaddy ( GDDY ) slipped almost 2% on Wednesday after the internet website-hosting company priced a $787.7 million secondary offering of nearly 10.4 million class A common shares at $75.75 each, or just 0.1% under Tuesday's closing price for the company's stock. The selling hareholders included affiliates of Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co LP ( KKR ), Silver Lake Partners and YAM Special Holdings - an entity owned by GoDaddy founder Bob Parsons. The company also sold 8,000 Class A shares in the offering.
- DXC Technology ( DXC ) was down almost 1% this afternoon, climbing back near its best levels of the session, after saying it has been awarded a $400 million technology contract with Wisconsin Medicaid. The contract has a five-year base period and also allows for five, one-year additional renewal options. DXC legacy companies have partnered with the Wisconsin DHS for over 40 years.
